# ship-isolation

Your interface to the `isolation` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`isolation.preview`](references/docs/isolation.preview.mdoc) — Resolve the isolation decision for an explicit tier/strategy without applying it.
- [`isolation.recommendations`](references/docs/isolation.recommendations.mdoc) — Per-tier isolation options with each strategy's availability and the recommended pick.
- [`isolation.status`](references/docs/isolation.status.mdoc) — Detected host sandbox capabilities + the strategy Ship would pick for the next agent run.
- [`isolation.verify`](references/docs/isolation.verify.mdoc) — Dry-run the recommended isolation decision end to end and report each check.
